The outbound call time with minute-level precision. If both this parameter and CallTimeList are specified, this parameter takes precedence. Use this parameter for minute-level precision. For example, for 08:31-12:05 13:33-19:00, pass [["08:31","12:05"]["13:33","19:00"]]. Default value: [["08:00","20:00"]].
